title: Tool calls are duplicated when execution starts
reasoning: An assistant toolCall appends a ToolUseStep and registers it by call ID. A subsequent tool_execution_start for that same ID unconditionally appends another step and replaces the pending entry. Completion updates only the second step, leaving a duplicate unresolved tool call in the trajectory. This distorts tool counts and the recorded execution history.
reproduction: Parse an assistant message_end containing toolCall ID 'a', followed by tool_execution_start and tool_execution_end with toolCallId 'a'. The trajectory contains two tool steps for one invocation, with the first result remaining null.
recommendation: Reuse the pending step when tool_execution_start references an already recorded call ID. Create a new step only when no corresponding call exists.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included, so existing coverage could not be verified.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover complete tool lifecycles both with and without preceding assistant toolCall blocks, including multiple interleaved call IDs; assert one step per invocation with the correct arguments and final result.
minimumFixScope: PiParser._process_tool_start and the relevant trajectory lifecycle tests.
